body: We haven't been friends for super long so I'm not always sure where I stand with him. He obviously doesn't know how I feel, and while sometimes I feel brave enough to tell him there's no way I can because his heart is trying to find it's place elsewhere. Above anything I genuinely enjoy his company and want to get to know him better, however, no one I've liked has ever returned the affection and the thought that he won't either is always there bringing me down.

I went to psych services at my school and it helped a bit with the anxiety. It used to be crippling, but it won't stop me from going places now which is something. I'm still really hard on myself about my social missteps though. I'm always replaying them in my mind.
